name: Antelog
summary: Safety layer for AI coding agents: writes down every action the agent wants to take, checks it, and stops dangerous commands before they run. Free to install on your machine.
description: Safety layer for AI coding agents: writes down every action the agent wants to take, checks it, and stops dangerous commands before they run. Free to install on your machine.

pricing.details: Starter 0 € (the page also shows a struck-through 9 €) — try it on your computer, 10,000 AI checks a month, 14 days of history, online dashboard, install free. Pro 14 €/month, or 90 € a year (official save 45%) — everything in Starter, 100,000 AI checks a month, up to 70% fewer false alarms, 1 year of history, email support. Team custom (unlimited checks, company rules, audit log and CSV export, SSO and self-hosting on request).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Safety layer for AI coding agents: records every action the agent wants to take, checks it, and stops dangerous commands
Official examples include blocking leaks, deleting production data, wiping home/project folders, force-pushes and key leaks
Works with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents; online dashboard
Starter is free to install on your machine
